name: smwgraphics-inner-human-body
title: Inner Human Body
description:
These ExGFX are custom and handrawn to look like the inside of the human body. For whatever use that involves the human body. The graphics themselves include the ground, slopes, teeth blocks, and a custom feather block as a bonus. Incase you're sick of using the map16 green switch palace block. The .zip file Includes ExGFX, palette, a readme, and the Map16page. More info in the Readme.

-Zildjian
